messages:
jamie: Heads up — starting RC creation for redwood-api:2026.06.2-rcA. Need quick QA, kv-warm, security signoff, and release notes. Target promo window 08:30-10:30 PT Fri. Can folks ack by EOD?

alex: Kicking off quick smoke on staging now (`smoke.sh --fast`). Will report failures within 20m.

maria: Scheduling KV warm on canary-c1 at 23:00 PT tonight. I'll post results.

security-bot: Automated scan started for RC artifact. Report expected in ~10m.

deploy-bot: RC created: `create-rc --artifact=redwood-api:2026.06.2-rcA --meta=rcA` queued as job id 1756669999-rc-create.

sre-oncall: Oncall here. I'll set watches: p95 > 450ms or error rate > 0.75% triggers pager.

jamie: Note: this RC includes a config tweak to model cache size. Security please confirm low risk.

taylor: I updated the release notes draft with the cache tweak and a note about reduced tokenization overhead. Please review.

security-bot: Scan complete: no high severities. One medium finding (unused secret in build image) — flagged for cleanup but acceptable for RC.

alex: Smoke passed: 0 failures. Snippet: `generate median 78ms, 95p 210ms`.

maria: KV-warm complete on canary-c1 — p95 improved ~25ms.

jamie: Good. Last call for objections. If none by 18:00 PT I'll pin and ask @deploy-bot to schedule promote in the window.

taylor: No objections from product. Keep DB migration flag OFF during promo.

sre-oncall: ACK. I'll be on watch for the lift.

jamie: Pinning artifact now and recording release notes. After pin I'll ask deploy-bot to schedule promote with traffic ramp 5%/30%/100% at 10m intervals.

deploy-bot: Artifact pinned. Promote scheduled for 08:30 PT 2026-06-18 to prod-us-west-2. Job id promote-1756669999-01. Config includes `--traffic-ramp 5,30,100 --interval-min 10`.

jamie: Rollback plan: immediate `rollback --to=redwood-api:2026.05.5` and traffic reversion to previous artifact. Incident comms template ready.

alex: Post-promote smoke will run automatically; will monitor logs and report any 5xx spikes. CI job: https://ci/redwood/jobs/promote-1756669999-01

maria: I'll be standing by to abort traffic ramp if p95 doubles or error rate spikes.

jamie: Thanks team. I'll post final release link after promote completes and close the RC thread. :rocket:
